turns.content: Oli otya ssebo? Ka kawungeezi kano kalabika kalungi!

Nfunyeeko akasaale k'ennyama ya mbuzi ewooma ennyo wano ku bbaala y'oku kyalo!
Hahaha! Ennyama y'embuzi eyookye eba tesalika musango! Nyumirwa obudde obwo naye tojjula nnyo.
Wasuze otya nno omulungi wange?
Wasuze bulungi munnange! Nzuukukidde mu kaseko olw'okubanga leero luli Lwakutaano. Eyo bwake butya?
Nze nzuukuse ne birowoozo bya kwanjula y'omukwano gwange gye tuliko enkya.
Aha! Kwanjula ya Baganda tesaagirwako, olina okwambala kkanzu yo ewooma n'osiba n'ekitambi eky'amanyi!
Gyebale ko nno banange! Mbadde mbateesezzaako.
Kale nnyo mukwano, nawe gyebale nnyo! Olunaku lukukoledde lutya gy'oli?
Mbadde mu katale k'e Nakasero, abakazi baano bansiize ennyanya z'omutendo!

Owange, otyano ku lunaku olw'enkya eno?
Ndi bulungi munnange! Enkya eno ewoomye nnyo. Ggwe ozuukuse otya?

Bambi! Sooka ofumbe caayi ow'enkanja (omukalu) oteekemu ebinzaali n'akasukali, ajja kukola amanyi ng'ogenda okufuna amata.
Nsanyuse nnyo okukusangako olwaleero!
Nange essanyu lya kitalo okukubalizaako! Ki ekiri ku mulyango gw'omutima gwo?

Bambi, osiibye otya nno munnange?
Nsiibye bulungi ssebo, wadde nga leero enjuba eyase nnyo! Ggwe ogumidde otya omusana guno?

Amazzi g'ensumbi galina engeri gye gakkakkanyamu omubiri etegeerekeka bulungi! Ganywe bulungi oleme kuggwamu mazzi.

Kiki ekipya ekiri eyo gy'oli?

Omupiira gwa Masaza guyingidde enkambi, ab'e Buddu n'aba Mawokota batandise okweranga!
